# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "tmm",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "tmm-theory.html",
    Implementation = "tmm-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "tmm-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "tmm-validation.html"
  )
)
```

TMM validation uses BEM, FEM, and hybrid FEM-BEM comparisons for spherical, spheroidal, cylindrical, and shell targets.

::: {.tip data-title="Reading residuals"}
Mean absolute residuals describe typical agreement across a sweep. Maximum residuals are retained because narrow TS nulls can dominate a single point.
:::

## TS-Frequency

| Validation method | Shape | Boundary / material | Frequency (kHz) | Angular grid | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| BEM | sphere | pressure release | 38 | 181 angles | 0.011 | 0.019 |
| FEM | sphere | elastic shelled | 12 | 91 x 181 | 0.000 | 0.000 |
| FEM | sphere | elastic shelled | 38 | 91 x 181 | 0.003 | 0.012 |
| FEM | sphere | elastic shelled | 70 | 91 x 181 | 0.001 | 0.003 |
| FEM | sphere | elastic shelled | 120 | 91 x 181 | 0.000 | 0.002 |
| hybrid FEM-BEM | prolate spheroid | liquid filled | 70 | 0-90 deg | 0.779 | 9.478 |
| hybrid FEM-BEM | prolate spheroid | liquid filled | 120 | 0-90 deg | 0.684 | 4.973 |

<details>
<summary>Hybrid FEM-BEM prolate orientation rows</summary>

| Frequency (kHz) | Angle (deg) | `TS` from hybrid FEM-BEM (dB) | `TS` from TMM (dB) | Delta `TS` (TMM - hybrid, dB) |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 70 | 0 | -121.457 | -124.256 | -2.799 |
| 70 | 30 | -127.800 | -127.869 | -0.069 |
| 70 | 60 | -100.324 | -100.269 | 0.055 |
| 70 | 90 | -76.954 | -76.950 | 0.003 |
| 120 | 0 | -114.967 | -114.895 | 0.072 |
| 120 | 30 | -108.736 | -110.970 | -2.233 |
| 120 | 60 | -103.213 | -103.129 | 0.083 |
| 120 | 90 | -80.520 | -80.560 | -0.040 |

</details>

## Boundary Conditions

| Validation method | Shape | Boundary / material | Frequency (kHz) | Angles | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| BEM | prolate spheroid | pressure release | 38 | 0, 45, 90 | 0.003 | 0.008 |
| BEM | oblate spheroid | pressure release | 38 | 0, 45, 90 | 0.005 | 0.009 |
| BEM | cylinder | pressure release | 38 | 70-115 | 1.371 | 4.332 |
| FEM | sphere | elastic shelled | 12-120 | full angular grid | 0.001 | 0.012 |

## Size And Shape

| Validation method | Shape | Boundary / material | Sweep | Frequency (kHz) | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| BEM | cylinder | pressure release | radius / length cases | 38 | 1.588 | 8.116 |
| BEM | cylinder | pressure release | monostatic shape cases | 38 | 55.517 | 272.091 |
| BEM | sphere | pressure release | angular slice | 38 | 0.011 | 0.019 |
| FEM | sphere | shell thickness | 12-120 | full angular grid | 0.001 | 0.012 |

## Residual Summary

| Axis | Method | Coverage | Mean abs. delta `TS` (dB) | Max abs. delta `TS` (dB) |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| TS-Frequency | FEM | elastic shelled sphere, 12-120 kHz | 0.001 | 0.012 |
| TS-Orientation | BEM | sphere and spheroid angular slices | 0.006 | 0.019 |
| TS-Orientation | hybrid FEM-BEM | liquid-filled prolate spheroid, 70 and 120 kHz | 0.732 | 9.478 |
| Boundary conditions | BEM/FEM | pressure-release, liquid-filled, and elastic-shelled branches | 0.347 | 4.332 |
